concerns.text: FR-008 requires analyzing confounds to 'ensure feature space coverage matches chemical diversity'. T011 calculates stats but lacks a task to perform the comparative analysis or generate a coverage report. The 'analysis' and 'ensure' parts of FR-008 are unimplemented.

SC-003 requires measuring rank correlation across ALL combinations of cutoffs and noise levels. T030b (noise) and T031b (sweep) are split, and T031c aggregates but lacks an explicit verification task to calculate the final correlation matrix against the 0.9 threshold for the full set of combinations as a single artifact.

FR-004/Plan.md state 'If N < 50, use all'. T020b enforces a hard RuntimeError if N < 50, contradicting the spec's fallback logic. The 'use all' path is missing a task to handle the subset selection and model training when N < 50.

T090, T091, T092, T093, T094, T095, T096 implement narrative reports and structural checks (Pauling constants, solvent sensitivity) not found in spec.md or plan.md. These are stale tags/scope creep referencing non-existent requirements.

T082a and T082b are marked 'REJECTED'/'REDO' in the text but remain in the task list with undefined verification schemas. These tasks reference non-existent or undefined artifacts (specific 'Addressing Research Concerns' section schema).
